title: Basement parking protrudes no more than 1 m above ground
text: Basement parking does not protrude more than 1m above ground, and where it protrudes above ground is designed or screened to prevent negative visual impact on the streetscape.
notes: parking.basement.present and parking.basement.protrusion_m (proposed; greatest height of the basement above natural ground level). 'Above ground' read as above natural ground level (verify: could be finished ground). Screening limb is A3.9.10-r1.

verified.note: p46 'above ground' is not defined (natural or finished ground level).
